scripts.test: bun test lib commands packages scripts
scripts.test:watch: bun test --watch lib commands packages scripts
scripts.test:all: bun test lib commands packages scripts && bun test --preload ./e2e/setup.ts --timeout 60000 e2e/
scripts.ui:build: cd ui && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w -X main.version=${RT_VERSION:-dev}" -o dist/rt-ui ./cmd/rt-ui
scripts.ui:test: cd ui && go vet ./... && go test ./...
